source.paper: Pawlowski & Traenkle, Effective action and black hole solutions in asymptotically safe quantum gravity, Phys. Rev. D 110, 086011 (2024), arXiv:2309.17043v2

generalized_EH_sector.note: Contains the linear-curvature sector and reduces to Einstein-Hilbert in the IR; it is not automatically credited as an independent residual direction after RQIR baseline subtraction.

reconstruction_logic.tt_3pt_p4: uniquely attributed to Ricci-tensor-squared form factor within the declared F2 basis
reconstruction_logic.tt_4pt_p4: after Ricci2 extraction, used to extract the R-squared form factor
reconstruction_logic.consequence: three-point plus four-point access reconstructs two quadratic-curvature form factors; n-point count must not be reinterpreted as four independent residual coordinates

anti_overcounting_rule: The rank of several observables generated by the same finite latent action basis cannot exceed the rank of the latent-to-observable map. Multiple 3pt/4pt probe rows do not create new independent theory parameters by themselves.
information_firewall: No polygon-derived QGR equations, architecture, fitted parameters, or repairs are admitted. KMQGB may only be compared after the Wave-29 independent verdict is frozen.
